webhooks.detail: Webhook Subscriptions API (OAuth only, no API keys) for order/contact etc. topics; 48h retries; send-test-notification endpoint

evidence.quote: Instead of making repeated API calls, a client may subscribe to notifications from Squarespace for supported system events.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox/test mode/free dev account found. Building a custom app needs a Squarespace Commerce Advanced plan (paid); OAuth client registration at account.squarespace.com/developer-apps. Only a send-test-notification webhook endpoint exists.

evidence.quote: With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.

rate_limits.summary: 300 requests/min (5 req/s) per Commerce API; 429 with 1-min cooldown; Create Order 100/hr per site with API key

evidence.quote: Squarespace Commerce APIs employ a rate limit of 300 requests per minute
